artifacts.summary: Independently re-derives the run-all.sh failure counts (174 suites/37 failing in the external-source-store repro env, not 26/156), confirms 6 of the 8 originally-named suites are genuinely caused by the missing-local-agent-system condition, shows 2 are misattributed (they fail identically in a repo with a local source store), flags a separate ~29-suite unrelated regression cluster as out of scope, and recommends extending each confirmed suite's path resolution through .claude-extensions.json's source_dir (the same read deploy-freshness-lib.sh already performs) rather than silencing them via known-failures.txt.

next_steps: Run /orchestrate 555 to create an implementation plan scoped to the 6 confirmed suites only (test-askuserquestion-rehome.sh, test-deploy-propagation.sh, test-routing-resolution.sh, test-update-task-status.sh, test-lint-dead-command-recommendations.sh, test-manifest-scripts-sync.sh); do not fold in the 2 misattributed suites or the unrelated regression cluster documented in the report.

memory_candidates.content: When a shell test suite under agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/tests/ needs real source-store content in a repo whose core extension is deployed from an EXTERNAL source (a repo lacking a local agent-system/ tree), resolve the real location via `jq -r '.extensions.core.source_dir // empty' .claude-extensions.json` rather than assuming `$REPO_ROOT/agent-system/extensions` exists under the git toplevel. This read is already implemented and proven fall-open in agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/lib/deploy-freshness-lib.sh's `_deploy_freshness_status_one` (checks source_dir is non-empty and is a directory before using it). deploy-root-guard.sh's opt-in self-correction path independently requires `agent-system/extensions` to exist directly under the git toplevel before accepting it as REPO_ROOT, which is exactly the assumption that breaks for an external-source-store consumer repo.

known-failures.txt is repo-wide and discovery-mode-insensitive by design (matches on basename, not full path, 'since discovery paths differ between source-store and deployed mode'). It is the wrong mechanism for a failure that is conditional on repo TOPOLOGY (local vs. external source store) rather than a fixed, host-independent defect: adding such a suite to known-failures.txt would silence it everywhere, including in a repo where it currently passes and should keep passing as a live regression signal.

claim_invalidations.claim: test-gate-cache-lib.sh and test-orchestrate-build-aux-dispatch.sh fail because this repository's core extension source store is external (the same cause as 5 other named suites).
